DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon inspects the ongoing drainage rehabilitation project along Bonifacio Drive on Monday, April 13.

He expressed confidence that the 200-meter project would be completed on schedule by May. The project involves doubling the size of drainage pipes to help ease flooding in key areas, including Burgos Avenue, Bonifacio Drive, and Roxas Boulevard.

Dizon also noted that the inner lane has been reinforced to withstand the heavy load of passing trailer trucks. 

📸: Mark Balmores/MB
